professionHooks.note: Herbalism window: from skill 50 pick Mageroyal in The Barrens (312 node spawns; densest patch /way The Barrens 47.2 41.4), together with Briarthorn (skill 70, 152 spawns). Stay on this loop while questing here until about 100. WoW Forever DB marks this as the Horde pick. Keep the herbs for Alchemy or First Aid potions, or sell them.

segments.t: Accept Crossroads Conscription from Kargal Battlescar
Turn in Ak'Zeloth to Ak'Zeloth

tips.text: If the Flawed Power Stone expires before you reach the altar, pick up the replacement stone. That repeat is not a second quest line.

segments.t: Accept The Demon Seed from Ak'Zeloth before you leave Far Watch Post. The altar is west of here, and you have to come back to the same orc to finish.
Use the Flawed Power Stone at the Altar of Fire, then go straight back to Ak'Zeloth. If the stone expires, a replacement exists, but it is the same errand.

sources.label: QuestieDB object 3525 The Altar of Fire spawn

segments.t: Turn in The Demon Seed to Ak'Zeloth, then take the road to the Crossroads. Do not stay for the repeatable stone unless the first one expired.
Get the flight path from Devrak

actions.label: Get the flight path from Devrak

tips.text: Get the Crossroads flight path first thing.

segments.t: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind

actions.label: Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind

tips.text: Set your hearth at the Crossroads; most of the next 7 levels loop back here.
Speedrun: take every Crossroads quest in one visit, then do them in loops (north-east camp, west pools, east to Ratchet) and only come back with several finished.
Set your hearth at this inn, the town you turn quests in, rather than in a capital.

sources.label: Mythic Store 2026-09-21: inns still grant rested XP

tips.text: Warchief's Blessing is shouted at the Crossroads (+300 health, 15% haste, not an xp buff; it drops on death). Optional.

segments.t: Visit Dokimi

tips.text: Forever: Dokimi (Durotar Supply and Logistics) stands in the trade camp just outside the Crossroads west gate. Hand in filled Waylaid Crates here for Merchant's Favor, which buys recipes no trainer teaches.

Waylaid Crates drop from mobs and chests while you quest. Fill one with any one of the bundles on its tooltip and bring it to Dokimi; your first crate also gives a Shipping Label quest worth 50 Merchant's Favor.

professionHooks.note: Keep Dig Rat from Dig Rat (The Barrens, lvl 1-1) for Dig Rat Stew. Recipe from the quest 'Dig Rat Stew' (id 862) from Grub. Recipe learnable at 90; every craft gives a point until 130 (about 40 crafts). Quest 'Dig Rat Stew' (Horde, quest level 23) teaches the recipe; Dig Rats drop from Barrens dig rats.

segments.t: Complete Plainstrider Menace

tips.text: Plainstriders are everywhere around the Crossroads. Kill them between other objectives instead of hunting them separately.
Finish this kill count before you change layer; do not switch layer in the middle of an objective.

Recipe learnable at 50; every craft gives a point until 90 (about 40 crafts). Barrens plainstriders; also needs Shiny Red Apple (vendor).
